title: Love 2D Connector
author: ScutFarkush
selftext:
I have been developing a game on love 2D using Claude code for the last 2 months. I experimented with having Claude make a connector into my game and it has saved me so much time and prompting. Claude can run my game and click on stuff, take screen shots, quickly build test build and gather data. For example, I ended up with a menu that I really liked, but non of my other menus matched. So I had it go in and make all the menus aesthetically and functionally uniform, and just from one prompt. I would say it will get 90% of the way there and then I go in a clean a few things up on my own, but it saved me so much time. I have mostly used it for UI stuff. I am avoiding ai art for this game, I have an artist for that side of it, I have not been super happy with ai art for my game, I use it only for place holders.

I also have it simulate outcomes to make sure I am getting the RNG right. I am making a unique roguelike, that’s all of the I fomo can give at the moment.

replies.author: ScutFarkush
replies.body: just as user ipreuss said below, i had claude code write it for me , i just told it what I needed it to do for me. it is a JSON API via HTTP. The best part is that it has evolved as I have built more and it will add functionality to the connector for other tests.

comments.body: Po bacana, eu comecei fazendo isso com o Cursor depois comecei a pagar o chatGPT e uso o Codex que acaba rendendo bem mais os tokens. Eu uso o GDevelop para criar meu jogo, usa muito arquivo json. Sempre ouço falar bem do Claude pra programar, queria saber se pra esse tipo de função é muito diferente pro codex ou cursor, vc ja chegou a testar outro além do Claude pra essa produção?

replies.author: ScutFarkush
replies.body: I used codex a little bit, and it felt about the same as Claude code for me. but I have the max plan on claude and I can run opus 4.7 on max and i have never hit my limits. but I am pretty sure they are super comparable at this point.

replies.author: Salinass94
replies.body:
Hoje eu assino por $20 o chatGPT (que inclui o codex) e larguei o cursor, então eu faço todo o planejamento + prompts na conversa do chatGPT de forma ilimitada e uso os tokens via VS Code com o codex que rende legal. Antes disso no lugar do codex usava o Cursor pagando mais $20 pro Cursor mas os tokens acabavam durando entre 10 - 15 dias do mês o que era pouco.
Só n assinei o Claude pq vejo muita gente falando que os tokens vão feito água, se vc testou e é bem parecido em questão de produção pros jogos acho que nem vale eu mudar ou pagar mais um
